verdict.rationale: Reflect's note-history docs say it continually records edits, so users can see all changes and revert a note to any point in time. That covers viewing version history and restoring earlier versions, though the evidence is a single first-party statement. Missing for 10: documented recovery of deleted notes (trash/restore), detail on the history UI and retention limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can view a note's version history and restore earlier versions or recover deleted notes

citations.quote: We continually record edits to notes which means you can see all your changes and revert a note to any point in time.
